'''Charles Napoleon Moore''' (1882–1967) was an American mathematician at [[Bowling Green State University]] who worked on [[Convergence tests|convergence factors]].<ref>{{Deprecated archive|url=https://archive.today/20121212012720/http://www.bgsu.edu/departments/math/history/page54109.html|title=brief bio of Charles Napoleon Moore}}</ref>

He was an Invited Speaker at the [[International Congress of Mathematicians|ICM]] in 1932 in Zürich.

His first doctoral student was [[Bess Marie Eversull]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=Bess Eversull - The Mathematics Genealogy Project |url=https://mathgenealogy.org/id.php?id=9779 |access-date=2024-07-15 |website=mathgenealogy.org}}</ref>
